title: Specify lead reconciliation envelope
description: Validates the request and response envelopes of the agent-led lead-reconciliation step per RFC-29 D2. `kind: request` is returned by `specrun plan propose --dry-run --format json`: a flat lead catalog plus locked/advisory reconciliation blocks, targets, and optional workspace projects. `kind: response` is the agent's grouping consumed by `specrun plan propose --from`: `lead-groups[]` partitions surveyed leads exactly once, while `slice-candidates[]` references those concepts and binds each `(concept-id, target)` pair to one target and optional project. The kernel validates this shape, enforces the global lead-partition and locked-block invariants, derives unique `plan.yaml.slices[]` names from optional `slice-name` or concept/target fallback, and writes through the existing plan writers; it never auto-merges on its own heuristic. Closed top-level shape: unknown fields are rejected.

leadKey.description: Stable request lead key in `<source>:<id>` form.

targetRef.description: Target adapter identifier, e.g. `omnia@v1` or `contracts@v1`. Mirrors `plan.schema.json` slice `target` pattern.

projectRef.description: One registered project from `registry.yaml`, surfaced into the request so the agent can bind each slice candidate to a project by matching the candidate's concept and target against the project's `target` and `description`.

name.description: Registry project name; the value the kernel writes to `plan.yaml.slices[].project`.

target.description: The project's registered target adapter. A slice candidate may only bind to a project whose registered `target` equals the candidate's `target`.

description.description: Single-sentence domain characterisation used by the agent when more than one project shares a target.

matchBasis.description: How a lead joined its final lead group. `exact-id` / `exact-alias` / `cross-reference` are deterministic kernel-computed matches; `semantic` is the agent's cross-source judgment and is surfaced for operator review.

lockedBasis.description: Kernel-computed proof basis for membership in a locked block.

blockingKey.description: Deterministic key used only to build advisory blocks, namespaced as `<kind>:<value>` (for example `domain:identity`, `module:auth`, `entity:user`, `route:/password/reset`, or `token:reset`).

blockRef.description: Request-side assignment of this lead to one reconciliation block. `basis` appears only when the kernel proved locked-block membership.

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary from the surveyed Lead.

aliases.description: Optional aliases from the surveyed Lead, used for exact-alias locked blocks and lexical fallback.

id.description: Stable id for a request-side reconciliation block. Response `lead-groups[].block-id` may cite advisory blocks for review traceability.

constraint.description: `locked` blocks are deterministic exact-id / exact-alias / cross-reference groups the agent may extend but not split. `advisory` blocks are search-space hints that do not constrain response membership.

keys.description: Block-level union of blocking keys that explain why the kernel formed this block. Lexical fallback keys use the `token:<term>` namespace.

adjacent-blocks.description: Locked block ids adjacent to this advisory block because an open lead shares a blocking key with a locked-block member. Invitation to consider extension, not a match decision.

projects.description: Registry topology in workspace mode: every entry from `registry.yaml#/projects[]` (name + target + description). Absent in single-repo mode.

blocks.description: Request-side reconciliation blocks computed by the kernel before agent grouping.

leads.description: Flat lead catalog. Each lead names at most one request-side block; unmatched leads omit `block`.

tentative.description: Agent-flagged low-confidence membership; surfaced for operator review at Gate 1.

concept-id.description: Concept id for a unit of work. Slice candidates reference this id; it is not necessarily the derived plan slice name.

block-id.description: Optional id of the request advisory block that most directly explains this grouping. Review traceability only; the kernel does not constrain membership by block.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for the grouping; rendered into change.md for operator review, most useful on semantic merges.

concept-id.description: Concept id of a declared `lead-groups[]` entry. May repeat across slice candidates when the same concept fans out to multiple targets.

slice-name.description: Optional explicit plan slice name for this `(concept-id, target)` candidate. When omitted, the kernel derives a unique slice name deterministically.

target.description: Exactly one target per slice candidate (one slice per `(concept-id, target)` pair, per D5). The same concept may appear under more than one target.

depends-on.description: Derived slice names this candidate depends on (not concept ids). Each name must resolve to a projected `plan.yaml.slices[]` entry.

project.description: Registry project this slice candidate binds to, chosen by the agent from the request's `projects[]`. Required on every candidate in workspace mode; omitted in single-repo mode.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for target or project binding when the choice is not obvious; rendered into change.md for operator review.
